The Goron spice used in preparing this crab pairs perfectly with the flavor of its meat.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Crab Stir-Fries are made by [[Cooking]] [[Goron Spice]] and any type of [[Crab]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. A regular Crab Stir-Fry can be made by either using two different types of Crabs or by adding a third [[Ingredient]] with a contradictory effect. When eaten, it will restore seven of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s to his [[Life Gauge]]. Alternatively, they can be sold for 50 [[Rupee]]s. The Goron Spice used is known to pair perfectly with the flavor of the crab meat. Three different variations of Crab Stir-Fry exist, correlating with the three different types of Crabs available: * '''Energizing Crab Stir-Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Crab Stir-Fry}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The Goron spice used in preparing this crab pairs perfectly with the flavor of the meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]s. Eating one will replenish a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They heal five Hearts, but they sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Mighty Crab Stir-Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Crab Stir-Fry}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The Goron spice used in preparing this crab pairs perfectly with the flavor of the meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Razorclaw Crab]]s. When consumed, Link's attack power will be temporarily boosted. They heal two Hearts and sell for 30 Rupees. * '''Tough Crab Stir-Fry''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Crab Stir-Fry}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The Goron spice used in preparing this crab pairs perfectly with the flavor of the meat.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Ironshell Crab]]s. If eaten, Link will have a higher [[Defense]] for a short period of time. They also heal for five Hearts and can be sold for 30 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Crab Stir-Fry reappears in {{TotK}}. It has the same [[Recipe]] that it did in {{BotW}}, which is to [[Cooking|Cook]] either a [[Bright-Eyed Crab]], [[Ironshell Crab]], or [[Razorclaw Crab]] with [[Goron Spice]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Crab Omelet with Rice * Crab Risotto * Food * Meal * Salt-Grilled Crab }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
